title: New multimodal AI models push reasoning benchmarks higher
summary: Leading AI labs released updated model cards showing gains in multi-step reasoning, code generation and long-context understanding — relevant reading for students building AI projects this semester.

title: AICTE releases updated model curriculum guidelines for 2026-27
summary: The revised guidelines emphasize outcome-based education, AI literacy across all engineering branches, and mandatory internship credits.

summary: Universities report faster classroom adoption of the latest Python release, citing improved performance and simplified typing syntax.

summary: A new report shows a sharp rise in undergraduate participation in silicon design competitions and open-source EDA tool contributions.

summary: The update brings guided, explain-first suggestions aimed at helping students learn rather than just autocomplete assignments.

title: UGC pushes for AI-integrated outcome-based assessment frameworks
summary: New draft guidelines encourage colleges to align assessments with measurable learning outcomes and responsible AI-assisted grading tools.

title: Google DeepMind publishes new research on efficient on-device inference
summary: The paper explores quantization techniques enabling large models to run on embedded and edge hardware — a growing intersection with embedded systems courses.

summary: Recruiters increasingly favor engineering graduates who can pair embedded systems fundamentals with applied machine learning skills.

title: NVIDIA expands student developer program with free GPU credits
summary: The updated program offers cloud GPU hours for verified students working on AI, robotics and simulation coursework.

title: Hugging Face releases lightweight models optimized for classroom labs
summary: The new model family targets low-resource environments common in college computer labs, making hands-on NLP experiments more accessible.

title: IIT open courseware adds new Digital Electronics lab simulations
summary: Interactive browser-based simulators now accompany several core electronics courses, reducing dependency on physical lab time.

title: Scholarship window opens for women in engineering and technology
summary: Multiple state and central government scholarship schemes for women pursuing electronics, computer science and AI programs are now accepting applications.

title: Microsoft AI updates Power BI with native AI-assisted data storytelling
summary: New copilot features help analysts and students generate narrative insights directly from dashboards — a useful addition for data analytics coursework.
